parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular wooden drawer that fits into the front of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or tools.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out horizontally along rails.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden panel located at the back of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel on the left side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and drawer structure.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel on the right side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and drawer structure.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Front Panel
parts.Basic_description: A curved wooden front panel beneath the tabletop.
parts.Functional_description: Adds aesthetic appeal and structural rigidity to the front of the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Left)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the front left corner of the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Right)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the front right corner of the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Left)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the back left corner of the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Right)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the back right corner of the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Left-Right)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the left and right legs.
parts.Functional_description: Increases lateral stability and prevents wobbling.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Front-Back)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the front and back legs.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat rectangular wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides the main working or placing surface for objects.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.
